lessons.claim: ★ In SAOS the normal stress difference oscillates at twice the frequency of the shear stress and the imposed flow (2 omega) -- lock in at omega only and the normal stress cannot be seen in principle (our lockin.k_star is an omega channel so it sees the shear component only). And eta' = G''/omega, eta'' = G'/omega are crossed over, so reversing the order is a common mistake
